# GeoMarmot

> Spatial ETL in the browser. A graph of transformers compiles to DuckDB-Wasm views; each
> transformer is one folder under transformers/ with index.js, README.md and tests.json.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): architecture, golden rules, commands
- [docs/transformer-api.md](docs/transformer-api.md): the transformer contract
- [docs/params.md](docs/params.md): every parameter kind
- [docs/engines.md](docs/engines.md): pure SQL, SQL + prepare, crs hooks
- [docs/code-economy.md](docs/code-economy.md): write less code

## Reference

- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)
- [docs/formats.md](docs/formats.md): readers and writers
- [docs/security.md](docs/security.md): proxy, SQL guard, AI privacy
- [docs/decisions/](docs/decisions/README.md)
